sourceFiles.scope: Selected already-reviewed Dark Shroud continuation versions only

scope: The complete First Forest encounter is read in its original quest context. Selected earlier siege/supply scenes, participant-authored quest histories and relevant narrator responses establish the other profile passages. Authored-message indexes and earlier supplied dossiers help discovery, not authority. No exhaustive life/archive review, attachment reconstruction or protected-origin claim. Existing unchanged paragraphs retain their earlier source scope.
boundaries: Serath intercepts Aleister’s Delerium strike, later offers her life-tether ankh and gives her soul. The narrator explicitly shows the transfer and Aionia’s restored life.
Thorn and Modeli offer their lives but remain alive; willingness is not a narrated second or third consumed soul. The Great Stag’s subsequent aid is distinct from Serath’s transfer.

Aionia’s account of Vain and wider destruction stays attributed. Vain is not seen in this encounter; the violet mist is not assigned his identity. No universal soul-exchange or resurrection rule is inferred.
Aionia’s address to Modeli does not establish biological parentage. Her lesson and Modeli’s self-blame remain attributed; Arethusa’s natural-order claim is not Codex doctrine.
Serath’s later revival is hoped for, not witnessed. The profile dates the checked later memories and does not invent an exhaustive present-day fate.
Thorn’s animal bargain ends in an accepted purchase of one cow; it does not establish that she frees every animal or completes a farm. Aionia’s promise of bounty is not a recorded harvest.
Modeli’s theories in The Before, suspicion at Hana’s table and plans for recovering supplies remain interpretations/plans. No completed unseen mission or proven evil host is manufactured.
The original 3 April First Forest day is retained; the new event preserves the local 3–4 April posting window and explains the continuation adjustment.

Only the existing Vain-warning event gains a sourced First Forest/Prima location and full-story destination; its date, rating and other fields survive. One distinct sacrifice consequence is added at World Changing, based on the observed caretaker restoration and return to battle.
No new image, raw transcript, private/controller material, or protected lore is copied into Git or the public site.
